guard.notes: Cursor supports project-level hooks (version 1 schema): .cursor/hooks.json registers a preToolUse hook that runs the guard with AGENT_RUNTIME=cursor and AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG=.agents/runtime/cursor/config.json via $CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR paths; exit 2 blocks the call. failClosed is false, so a crashed or timed-out hook lets the call through - the guard is a layer on top of Cursor's own approvals, not a replacement for checking doubtful calls by hand.

permissions.notes: Approve and deny live in the IDE's own agent settings; the guard policy is enforced through the preToolUse hook in .cursor/hooks.json (fail-open on hook errors). Structural changes to roles, agents or skills always need explicit user approval, in every mode.
